findings.finding: Ignorer l’avis: sibling “Dismiss … notice” labels (ui.browser.browser_passkey_notice.dismiss, ui.browser.browser_file_transfer_row.dismiss_download_notice/_upload_notice, ui.common.updates.update_quiet_indicator.dismiss_update_notice, ui.settings.configuration…dismiss_this_notice) all use Masquer (Masquer l’avis de clé d’accès, …); Ignorer matches this band's prompt_dismiss and is a common fr Dismiss (ui.agentMessages.banner.dismiss). Accessible name only. Optional: Masquer l’avis. No change.
Button name Autoriser is unquoted (every arm); « Autoriser » (U+202F inside) would mirror ru/zh-CN. Same call as round-1 FR-N1. No change.

Réglages Système › Confidentialité et sécurité equals the audited media_permission hint; Ouvrir Réglages Système follows Apple's article-less app-name usage; no : ; ! ? in any value, so no U+202F needed; apostrophes are U+2019; vous register.

Round-2 remediation (748f4c83caf) made blocked_hint a devices select, resolving the a2 source observation (“them” for one device); the component now passes devices (browser-media-permission-prompt.tsx:152). l’utiliser (U+2019) covers micro (m.) and caméra (f.) alike; les for both.

The other 8 keys are byte-identical to the values audited as mp1843-a2-fr at 99d69f364e3 (JSON key-by-key compare of git show 99d69f364e3: vs 748f4c83caf:; only blocked_hint differs in en, context and this locale); a2 verdicts on them are carried, re-run mechanically here.
